celine: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a short 'admin wrangling' drive this week to knock down stale admin entitlements and collect evidence for compliance. Low-friction first pass: remove admin binds with no activity for 120+ days unless owner confirms in 48h. :wave: raj: SGTM. Scope = org admins + project-admin roles + explicit KMS admins? julia: + service accounts that have admin bindings (they tend to linger). Also need to be careful with KMS roles — removal may break decrypts if a key policy relies on that principal. celine: Agreed. Plan: - Phase 1 (48h): owner outreach + automated ownerproof export - Phase 2 (72h): canary removals (5% of affected binds) for low-risk projects - Phase 3 (7 days): bulk prune + final evidence bundle to compliance raj: Who's running the owner outreach? I can wire up the notify template and throttle DMs. celine: Thanks — can you post the template in this thread? Short message, link to evidence, and one-click 'keep' or 'relinquish' buttons. raj: Template draft: ``` Hi <@owner>, we detected an admin binding on with no activity for 120+ days. Please confirm within 48h if this binding should be retained. Reply "KEEP" to keep, or click "RELINQUISH" to mark for removal. Contact security if unsure. ``` julia: For the KMS-admins question: before any removal, we need to run a key-access simulation: `kms-sim --principal

--keys affected.list` and a quick `decrypt-check` against a small sample of ciphertexts. If simulation fails, pause removal for that binding. tariq: I can own the canary phase and run the simulations. Recommend selecting canary targets from non-prod namespaces only (a few infra projects) and leaving payment/production projects out. opsbot: access-scan results ready: 1) ownerless_admin_bindings: 64 2) admin_bindings_idle_120d: 312 3) kms_admins_with_keys: 27 (Full CSV: https://internal-storage/reports/admin-drive-1718045623.csv) celine: Good. Let's pick 5 canary targets from the 312 that are low-risk. Tariq, can you share the list before removal? tariq: Will do. I'll also create a short rollback runbook. Preliminary rollback steps: - reapply role binding via `rbac-tool apply --from backup/` - restart dependent services if decrypt errors occur - notify oncall and security channel with incident tag `#admin-prune-fail` julia: Also ensure audit logging retention is set to >=90 days for all affected projects so we can assemble ownerproof evidence. If any project has short retention, escalate to logging infra; we need at least 90-day trails per comreq. raj: Ownerproof export command I'm using: `rbac-tool ownerproof --binding --output /tmp/ownerproof-.json`. We'll attach those to the outreach DM. celine: Compliance asks for a simple CSV with binding id, resource, principal, last_active_ts, owner, decision. Let's make that the canonical artifact. opsbot: compliance-checker invoked: detected 3 projects with log-retention <90d: infra-monitoring, dev-test-us, ci-builders. Raising tickets. raj: I'll add a note in the DM for owners in those projects: "audit logs limited — we'll preserve evidence snapshot for compliance". tariq: One more risk: some service principals are used only by ephemeral batch jobs that run monthly. Last_active_ts might be >120d but they're still required. We should cross-check with job-scheduler (crondb) for monthly schedules. I'll add that check to the pipeline. celine: Great catch. Add `--cron-check` flag to the scan. raj: Timeline recap: outreach starts now, canary in 72h (tariq), bulk prune at +7 days unless flagged. I'll share the notify template and the outreach list this afternoon. julia: I'll own KMS-sim and decrypt sampling; will post failures to this thread. celine: If anything risky pops up, call a pause and we escalate via oncall. Otherwise we'll proceed. Thanks team :thumbsup: opsbot: automated-reminders scheduled: outreach reminders at +24h and +40h. raj: Template and outreach CSV uploaded: https://internal-storage/outreach/admin-drive-outreach-1718045623.csv celine: Recording this decision and owners here for audit: outreach=raj, canary=tariq, kms-validation=julia, evidence bundle=celine. If anyone needs to swap, shout now. raj: one nit — update the DM to include a fallback contact: security@redwood.com. celine: done. We'll report back after canary completes with a short postmortem-style note (what failed, what needed rollback, and any policy changes).
